course.standardRef: EASA PART 66 MODULE 5 DIGITAL TECHNIQUES/ELECTRONIC INSTRUMENT SYSTEMS
course.learningOutcomes: Understand and be able to apply Numbering Systems, Data conversion, Logic Circuits and Theory application, Fundamental of each particular Numbering, Fiber optics devices, and Computer Structure with Safety awareness, Electro Static Sensitive Devices in an Electromagnetic Environment tasks with Safety awareness in Safety Management Control tasks.
course.objectives:
1. To provide knowledge concerned about Numbering Systems, Data conversion, Logic Circuits and Theory application.
2. To provide the Safety awareness in Safety Management Control tasks.
3. To provide attitudes, and Habit desirable while performing the Electro Static Sensitive Devices in an Electromagnetic Environment tasks.
4. To provide the application concepts while performing the Fiber optics devices, and Computer Structure with safety awareness.
course.competencies:
1. Describe and codify Knowledge about the Fundamental of each particular Numbering, Data conversion, and Logic Circuit devices correctly 
2. Demonstrate wiring the Fiber optics devices circuits correctly.
3. Perform checking Electro Static Sensitive Devices with the safety mildness.
4. Perform testing the Logic Circuits and Theory application correctly.
5. Apply checking Electro Static Sensitive Devices with the safety mildness.
course.description: To study in the concept of Numbering Systems, Data Conversion, Data Buses, Logic Circuits that is Identification of common logic gate symbols, tables and equivalent circuits, Basic Computer Structure. Fiber optics, Electronics Displays, Electrostatic Sensitive Device, Software’s Management Control and Electromagnetic Environment.
